angle: Curiosidade e impacto de NASA’s ESCAPADE Completes Powered Earth Flybys, Now En Route to Mars
summary: NASA’s two ESCAPADE (Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers) spacecraft have each successfully completed a powered Earth flyby, using Earth’s gravity in combination with a sustained engine burn to slingshot themselves toward Mars. With these successful maneuvers complete, the twin spacecraft are on target to reach the Red Planet in September 2027.
script: Isso acabou de acontecer na ciência e tecnologia: NASA’s ESCAPADE Completes Powered Earth Flybys, Now En Route to Mars. De acordo com relatórios publicados pela NASA News, os novos dados confirmam: NASA’s two ESCAPADE (Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers) spacecraft have each successfully completed a powered Earth flyby, using Earth’s gravity in combination with a sustained engine burn to slingshot themselves toward Mars. With these successful maneuvers complete, the twin spacecraft are on target to reach the Red Planet in September 2027.
